nodes.name: Voice (voice-speak)
nodes.notes: Calls Ibrahim's voice-speak workflow to turn the final text into audio. If it fails, the next node still returns the text without audio.

nodes.name: Attach audio
nodes.notes: Adds the base64 mp3 to the message as audio (audio_mime audio/mpeg). If voice failed, audio is null and audio_error is set, so the app can show text only.

meta.note: Export of the live workflow on futureyou.app.n8n.cloud. After import, re-select the credentials (Anthropic / ElevenLabs Header Auth). Contains no secrets.
